files.caption:
Kansas Homestead of Thomas McQuill(i)an
Located less than 50’ west from the farmhouse, the garage is a one-story, rectangular building oriented lengthwise from north to south. It is approximately 15’x18’ in dimension.

files.title: File:Kansas Homestead of Thomas McQuill(i)an Douglas Co KS garage south elevation looking north.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Kansas Homestead of Thomas McQuill(i)an
 The structure is wood frame clad in corrugated metal sheathing on the north, west, and east façades and tongue and grooved vertical board sheathing on the south façade.
